regionalImagery.credit: NASA Earth Observatory / Reto Stöckli, Blue Marble Next Generation, June 2004, topography and bathymetry shaded
regionalImagery.processing: Two native 500 m JPEG tiles cropped and joined at 90 E. No upsampling, synthetic detail, or changed elevation. Global originals are temporary; retained artifacts are the regional crop and provenance.
regionalImagery.notes: Shading is baked into the NASA display image. It is not higher-resolution DEM and not present-day imagery.

qualityNotes: Tianchi z=14 rejected: implausible negative lake-area samples. Use a validated lower source level; no synthetic filling.
Procedural grain, strata, cavity shading, water ripples and ice crevasses affect display only, not measured elevations.

tianchi.distribution: Element 84 Earth Search / AWS Sentinel-2 COGs
tianchi.processing: Native 10 m TCI (B04/B03/B02); cropped UTM window, bilinear reprojection to DEM WGS84 bounds, north-up JPEG quality 95. No AI upscaling, invented colours, terrain displacement, cloud filling or multi-date mosaic.
tianchi.quality: Selected from low-cloud July–September candidates (Tianchi: 2024; glacier: 2023–2025). Crop SCL statistics and visual inspection recorded; SCL is a 20 m automatic classification, not manual ground truth.
